title: METAIS finding-code registry
description: The registry of finding codes, spec/findings/registry.json: one entry per code, in the byte order of the codes. A code's meaning, severity, class and subject kind never change within a major version; its params may gain members, never lose one or change one's type; a code the tool no longer emits stays, marked retired.

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: Every registered code, in the byte order of the codes.

entry.title: Registry entry
entry.description: One finding code and everything a finding with it always has.

code.title: Code
code.description: A dotted lowercase name of two to four segments, at most 64 bytes, whose first segment is a family of the closed list.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: The severity every finding with this code has.

class.title: Class
class.description: The kind of failure the code reports, which decides the exit status.

subject.title: Subject kind
subject.description: The subject kind every finding with this code is reported with.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: The code's parameters, in the order a finding's params object lists them.

message.title: Message template
message.description: The reference wording of the message: plain text with {name} placeholders naming a parameter that is always present or one of the built-ins field, input, output and package; {{ and }} write literal braces.

hint.title: Hint template
hint.description: The reference wording of the hint, the next step, in the message template's form.

location.title: Span
location.description: Which character a finding's line and column mark: the value, the member's key, or the parent object that lacks a member; none for a code whose findings never carry a location.

since.title: Since
since.description: The specification minor that added the code.

retired.title: Retired
retired.description: The specification minor from which the tool no longer emits the code. Absent while it is emitted.

statements.title: Statements
statements.description: The identifiers of the normative statements the code reports.

type.title: Type
type.description: The parameter's JSON type. A number is in canonical JSON number form.

items.title: Element type
items.description: An array parameter's element type. Absent when its elements may be any number, string or boolean.

always.title: Always present
always.description: Whether every finding with the code has the parameter.
